tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search open jobs in Switzerland and Liechtenstein by keywords and filters. Only jobs whose advert is still online are returned. Returns up to 20 jobs per page, newest first for filter-only searches; keyword searches rank by relevance, favouring recent adverts and mixing companies. Use get_job for a

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Full details of one job by its id from search_jobs: facts, salary, description (usually a jopp brief) and the link to the original advert.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: jopp's occupation categories and their roles, for the category and role filters of search_jobs. Pass a category key to get its roles with typical job titles.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Keyword search over open jobs in Switzerland; returns ids, titles and links. search_jobs offers filters and more fields.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full text of one job by its id from search, as a readable document.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
